verdict.rationale: A tax agency's e-services portal could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring background actions, such as scheduled payments or auto-filing, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows one-off, user-initiated actions: interactive electronic filing, batch enrollment files, and large-data-file submission. It documents no user-configurable automation that runs autonomously on a recurring schedule. Batch uploads are one-off submissions, not recurring background automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
